description: Intent i015 (net-epidx, snapshot s04) complete. Four reportable variants of the seed mechanism (untrusted descriptor-declared bNumEndpoints vs assumed fixed endpoint index) found, with exact source evidence: (1) drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3582-3592 (high confidence) — lan78xx_probe sets ep_blkin/ep_blkout/ep_intr = cur_altsetting->endpoint + 0/1/2 with no bNumEndpoints check; the only prior validation (lan78xx_bind->lan78xx_get_endpoints, lines 2755-2811, called at 3571) requires bulk in/out in some altsetting but never calls usb_set_interface, so cur_altsetting may be a different, even 0-endpoint altsetting; ep_intr->desc.bEndpointAddress then programs dev->pipe_intr via usb_rcvintpipe and .bInterval sets the interrupt-URB period that sizes the kmalloc'd intr buffer and usb_fill_int_urb — OOB read at plug-in. (2) drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1352-1436 (medium) — alloc_all_mem reads ep_intr = alt->endpoint + 2 with zero bNumEndpoints checks in the entire file; ep_intr->desc.bInterval (line 1433) feeds usb_fill_int_urb, reached via rtl8152_open:3275. (3) drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/hif_usb.c:1213-1253 (medium) — send_eject_command, called at probe for STORAGE_DEVICE IDs (line 1273), reads endpoint[1].desc then endpoint[0] with no count check; the OOB-read bEndpointAddress programs usb_sndbulkpipe. (4) drivers/net/wireless/zydas/zd1211rw/zd_usb.c:1272-1312 (medium) — eject_installer is the original of the ath9k copy, same unvalidated endpoint[1]/[0] reads at probe (line 1366). Evidence-backed negatives (18 candidates recorded): usbnet_get_endpoints, cdc-phonet, cdc_ether, sierra_net, hso, brcmfmac, rtlwifi, orinoco_usb, p54usb, at76c50x, libertas, libertas_tf, mwifiex, mt7601u, rt2x00, rtl8xxxu, and rsi all bound their endpoint loops by bNumEndpoints and/or validate counts/NULLs before use. Limitations: qmi_wwan.c:304 (control-interface endpoint[0] without a visible count check) remains unresolved because qmi_wwan_bind/usb_cdc_wdm_register were not fully traced; no runtime fuzzing/compilation reproducer was run (read-only snapshot); drivers/net/wwan does not exist in s04; r8152 trigger requires interface up rather than mere plug-in and the OOB value only affects the URB interval.
